# Opus Health

> > Opus Health provides comprehensive addiction treatment and mental health services in Orange County, California, including residential rehab, medical detox, and outpatient programs.

Located in Costa Mesa, Opus Health serves Southern California communities including Huntington Beach, Santa Ana, Garden Grove, and San Diego with evidence-based therapies like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and Virtual IOP options.
